No, that is not true. 

EU and EFTA citizens who work in Switzerland have the right to live in Switzerland under the free movement of persons agreement between Switzerland and the EU. They do not need to return home every day, nor are they restricted to specific border zones. As long as they are gainfully employed in Switzerland, they can reside anywhere in Switzerland – not just in border regions. However, it is important to note that eligibility for residence permits depends on having a valid job contract or being self-employed and meeting other administrative requirements (such as registering with the local authorities and obtaining a residence permit).

If someone is commuting and not living in Switzerland, they are subject to different rules, but this does not apply to those who reside and work in Switzerland on the basis of free movement.
